excerpt.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是[capital_scope.GetName]突然关停，城市内的每个光源都被熄灭。而[capital_scope.GetName]的居民所经历的更糟糕：车辆变成了路障，工厂停止运转，医院设备处于无响应的状态。这是一次全球性的突然停电，突如其来，莫名其妙。

当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root.GetTechnicianPlural]仍然在抓瞎——是的，字面意义上的抓瞎。
excerpt.en: What our people saw from orbit was [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on [capital_scope.GetName] experienced was much worse: vehicles reduced to road blocks, factories grinding to a halt,

scope.zh: 整条万华镜故事：开局与五年检查入口、首次停电项目、局势与喂养、每月插曲、四种结局、间谍行动转移、宿主更换首都/被灭亡、迪斯科球。
scope.en: Whole Kaleidoscope story: game-start and five-year entry, first blackout project, situation and feeding, monthly interludes, four endings, espionage hand-off, capital move/host destruction, Disco Sphere.

uncertain: The value scripts kaleidoscope_good_ending_chances / kaleidoscope_negative_events_value / kaleidoscope_positive_events_value were not traced in common/script_values; the guide gives only base weights.

label.zh: 发动间谍行动“引诱万华镜”
把戴森球改建为迪斯科球并完工
label.en: Upgrade a Dyson Sphere to the Disco Sphere and finish it

label.zh: 目标日后陷入能量赤字（30年内）
label.en: If the target later falls into an energy deficit (within 30 years)

note.zh: on_progress_complete 的 random_list：绽放基础权重10、爆炸90，按心情值 kaleidoscope_good_ending_chances 调整。
note.en: on_progress_complete random_list: bloom base 10, explosion base 90, shifted by value:kaleidoscope_good_ending_chances (mood).

label.zh: 宿主的结局（只发生其一）
label.en: How it ends for the host (one of these)

note.zh: 撑爆（2041/2043）、25年寿命到期消散（2040）、迪斯科球（2049）或通过间谍行动送走（2021）。宿主被灭亡时由征服者接手或消散（隐藏事件2060）。
note.en: Burst (2041/2043), fade when its 25-year lifetime ends (2040), the Disco Sphere (2049), or passing it on by espionage (2021). If the host is destroyed, the conqueror inherits it or it fades (hidden 2060).

label.zh: 每月随机插曲（可重复、无固定顺序）

note.zh: on_monthly random_events：无事100，各事件1，无尽的饥饿2。不喂养时多为负面事件，喂养时多为正面事件。
note.en: on_monthly random_events: nothing 100, each event 1, Endless Hunger 2. Starving it allows the negative events, feeding it the positive ones.

texts.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是[capital_scope.GetName]突然关停，城市内的每个光源都被熄灭。而[capital_scope.GetName]的居民所经历的更糟糕：车辆变成了路障，工厂停止运转，医院设备处于无响应的状态。这是一次全球性的突然停电，突如其来，莫名其妙。

当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root.GetTechnicianPlural]仍然在抓瞎——是的，字面意义上的抓瞎。
texts.en:
What our people saw from orbit was [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on [capital_scope.GetName] experienced was much worse: vehicles reduced to road blocks, factories grinding to a halt, hospital equipment lifeless and inert. A world-wide blackout, as sudden as it was inexplicable.

As silence and shadows veiled our world, strange light patterns bloomed in the sky, enveloping our capital system in a kaleidoscopic mist. The two events are doubtlessly related, but our [root.GetTechnicianPlural] are still - literally - in the dark.

notes.zh: 开局隐藏事件1999以30%概率决定本局是否出现万华镜（需复仇女神DLC）；中期之后每五年随机检查（权重50/200）由2000选择宿主：人类玩家帝国5、玩家邻国3、AI帝国1，0–360天后到达。
notes.en: Hidden 1999 decides at game start (30%) whether the Kaleidoscope can appear (Nemesis DLC); after mid-game a five-year random pulse (weight 50/200) runs 2000, which picks the host: a human player's empire 5, a player's neighbour 3, an AI empire 1, arriving after 0-360 days.

texts.zh: 能源电网的全球性故障使我们的首都陷入了完全的黑暗。我们必须恢复[root.GetName]的电力基础设施，并压实相应责任主体。
texts.en: A global failure of the energy grid has plunged our capital into total darkness. We must restore [root.GetName]'s power infrastructure and determine what is taking place.

texts.zh:
我们在自己的电网系统中找不到任何缺陷。我们的发电机正在产生能量，但是某种存在……某种存在正在吸收它。这可能是我们在天空中能够观察到光图案的结果，这个图案的几何性质透露出一定的智慧痕迹。

这个东西——这个活着的万华镜——是一个满怀恶意的存在，还是一团无意识的迷雾？答案尚未明确。
texts.en:
We can find no defects in our power grid. Our generators are producing energy, but something is... absorbing it. It may be a result of the light patterns witnessed in our skies, the geometric nature of which betray an intelligent design.

Is this thing - this living Kaleidoscope - a malicious entity, or just a mindless mist? The answer is unclear.

label.zh: 试图将它从我们的电网中剥离出来。
label.en: Attempt to detach it from our power grid.

texts.zh:
多亏了我们的[owner.GetTechnicianPlural]和[owner.GetScientistPlural]的通力合作，我们设法将能量寄生虫从我们的电力网络中剔除了。我们最漫长的黑夜已经过去，但是万华镜寄生虫仍然在我们的头顶上闪耀，渴望能量。

我们无法与它进行交流，常规武器对这类生物无效。我们剩下的选项是给它提供足够的能量以维持其心情满足，或者试图让它挨饿。我们的特工还建议组织一次谍报行动，将它引诱到另一个帝国。让其他人来处理它。
texts.en:
Thanks to the coordinated effort of our [owner.GetTechnicianPlural] and [owner.GetScientistPlural], the energy parasite has been cut from our power grid. Our longest night is over, but the Kaleidoscope still shines upon us, hungry for energy.

We have no way to communicate with it, and conventional weaponry won't work on a being of this kind. Our remaining options are to feed it just enough to keep it appeased, or try to starve it. Our operatives also suggested organizing an Espionage Operation to lure it towards another empire. Let someone else deal with it.

texts.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是一个熟悉的图案再次出现：[capital_scope.GetName]上的所有电源突然关闭，我们的首都受到全球停电的打击，而熹微的光亮在天空中跃动。
万华镜回来了！我们曾经将这个能量寄生虫诱骗到其他国家，现在又给送了回来。

根据我们专家的分析，投资建设一个行星护盾生成器能够防止我们的首都再次成为目标，但是一切都为时已晚：因为能量寄生虫已经待这儿不走了。
texts.en:
What our people saw from orbit was the repetition of a familiar pattern: all power on [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, our capital hit by a worldwide blackout while shimmering lights danced in the sky.
The Kaleidoscope has returned! The energy parasite we once foisted onto others has been sent back to us.

According to our experts, investing in a Planetary Shield Generator will prevent our capital from being targeted again, but it's too late for now: the energy parasite is here to stay.

label.zh: 这个非自然的野兽别想在我们的恒星系容身！
label.en: The unnatural monster has no space in our system!

tooltips.zh: 解锁谍报行动引诱万华镜寄生虫
tooltips.en: Unlocks Espionage Operation Lure the Kaleidoscope

label.zh: 我们必须和这个奇迹之兽交好！
label.en: We must befriend this wondrous creature!

tooltips.zh: 解锁谍报行动引诱万华镜寄生虫
tooltips.en: Unlocks Espionage Operation Lure the Kaleidoscope

label.en: It wants energy? Let it choke on it.

tooltips.zh: 解锁谍报行动引诱万华镜寄生虫
tooltips.en: Unlocks Espionage Operation Lure the Kaleidoscope

texts.zh:
一种五彩斑斓的能源寄生虫正在侵染我们的能源电网，提高了我们的能源供给。我们可以放任它，或者通过谍报行动将这个麻烦传导到其他帝国。

[GetKaleidoscopeMood]。
texts.en:
A colorful energy parasite is infecting our power grid, feasting on our energy supplies. We could indulge it, or use an Espionage Operation to pass this problem to another empire.

[GetKaleidoscopeMood].

sections.zh: 让万华镜寄生虫挨饿会降低它的心情，提高负面事件的发生几率。给它投喂会提高它的心情，维持它愉悦和稳定。
sections.en: Starving the Kaleidoscope will lower its mood, increasing the chance of negative events. Feeding it will increase it, keeping it appeased and placid.

sections.zh: 让万华镜寄生虫挨饿会降低它的心情，提高负面事件的发生几率。给它投喂会提高它的心情，维持它愉悦和稳定。
sections.en: Starving the Kaleidoscope will lower its mood, increasing the chance of negative events. Feeding it will increase it, keeping it appeased and placid.

label.zh: 发动间谍行动“引诱万华镜”

notes.zh: 不喂养不增长进度；少量喂养每月+0.5，大量喂养+1.5。宿主更换首都时万华镜随之移动（2050）；宿主被灭亡时，未装行星护盾的征服者接手，否则消散（2060）。
notes.en: Starving adds no progress; feeding adds 0.5/month, overfeeding 1.5. It follows the host's capital when the capital moves (2050); if the host is destroyed, an unshielded conqueror inherits it, otherwise it fades (2060).

texts.zh:
我们有幸得出体验星系最壮观的灯光秀：万华镜的花瓣往复折叠、盛开、绽放！然而，我们的仪器则带来了一则不那么令人高兴的消息。

这种能量生物变得如此充满力量，它甚至像一颗垂死的恒星一样发生了坍缩。在它的废墟中，我们的探测器发现了一个外形非常类似花朵的晶体团簇。根据初步研究，这种“花”可以放大最微弱的光线，在这个过程中打破了一些已知的物理定律。我们的[root.owner.GetScientistPlural]推测，这种花不过是一座光线可以被无限地反射叠加的多维镜屋中可见的冰山一角。
texts.en:
We have been blessed to experience the galaxy's most splendid light show: kaleidoscopic petals folding into themselves; blooming; exploding! However, our instruments tell a less triumphant story.

The energy being became so full of power it collapsed into itself like a dying star. From the devastation, our probes retrieved a crystalline cluster, shaped very much like a flower blossom. According to preliminary studies, the 'flower' can magnify the intensity of the faintest light ray, breaking a few known laws of physics in the process. Our [root.owner.GetScientistPlural] hypothesize the flower is merely the visible part of a larger construct - a multi-dimensional house of mirrors where light beams are infinitely reflected and recombined.

note.zh: 获得遗珍“真空花朵”，局势结束。
note.en: Grants the Vacuum Flower relic; the situation ends.

texts.zh: 传感器报告[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系中万华镜的图案发生了剧烈的绽放，并在五彩斑斓的爆炸中消失了。那场面一定相当壮观。
texts.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system just bloomed, disappearing in a final burst of colorful patterns. Must have been quite the spectacle.

texts.zh:
万华镜自我折叠的一瞬，它看起来就像一朵最精致的水晶花。然而，随之而来的爆炸一点也不温和：一股灼热的爆炸席卷了整个星系，我们所有的电子设备都发生了过载，烧焦了能源电网。

维修工作已经在进行中，但我们还需要一段时间才能适应这片空旷的天空。
texts.en:
When the Kaleidoscope folded into itself, just for a second, it looked like the most delicate crystalline flower. However, the ensuing explosion was anything but gentle: a coruscating boom that scorched the system and overloaded all our electronic devices, frying our energy grid.

Repairs are already underway, but it will take some time for us to get used to the newly empty sky.

note.zh: 星系内殖民地+50荒芜度，局势结束。
note.en: Colonies in the system gain 50 devastation; the situation ends.

texts.zh: 传感器报告在[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系的万华镜图案爆炸了，释放了一道能量冲击波损坏了星系中所有的设施。
texts.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system just exploded, releasing an energy shockwave that doubtlessly damaged every structure in the system.

texts.zh: 传感器回报我们在[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系探测到的万华镜图案已经消退了。
texts.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern we detected in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system has faded away.

texts.zh: 一只饥肠辘辘的万华镜寄生虫将双齿深深扎进了[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]的能量电网中。随之而来的全殖民地范围的大停电颇为剧烈，但与此前的攻击并不相似。我们已经知道怎么对付这东西了。
texts.en: A starved Kaleidoscope has sunk its metaphorical teeth into [event_target:infested_planet.GetName]'s energy grid. The ensuing colony-wide blackout was dramatic, but not dissimilar from previous attacks. We know how to deal with this.

texts.zh:
又一次，万华镜寄生虫锁死了我们的电网，消耗我们的能源供给，使行星陷入黑暗。

幸运的是，我们现在知道如何应对。
texts.en:
Once again, the Kaleidoscope has latched to our power grid, consuming our energy and plunging the planet into darkness.

Fortunately, we now know how to respond.

texts.zh: 依照我们经过验证和测试的流程，我们将万华镜寄生虫从[root.GetName]的能量电网中剥离，恢复了首都的供电。
texts.en: Following our proven and tested procedures, we detached the Kaleidoscope from [root.GetName]'s energy grid, restoring power to our capital.

texts.zh: 一只贪婪的万华镜正试图强行连接到我们在[target.GetName]上的能量中枢。这提供了一个研究这只生物独特能力的绝佳机会，但我们预计这座建筑将因此受到严重破坏。
texts.en: A ravenous Kaleidoscope is trying to forcibly connect itself to one our Energy Nexus on [target.GetName]. This presents a remarkable opportunity to study the being's unique abilities, but we expect the building will be severely damaged as a result.

label.zh: 就让它吃点我们的能量吧。为了科学！
label.en: Let it eat our energy. For Science!

texts.zh: 万华镜焦躁地颤动着，让我们的天空充满了不和谐、不均匀的光线。我们的人不禁觉得这种景象令人不安。
texts.en: The Kaleidoscope trembles nervously, filling our skies with jarring, uneven patterns of light. Our people can't help but find the spectacle unnerving.

texts.zh: 万华镜犹如一道敞开的窗口，让我们的天空充满了不祥而病态的图案。我们的祭祀认为这是凶兆。也许明智的做法是牺牲一些能量给这个生物，消除它的饥饿，平息我们人民的恐惧。
texts.en: The Kaleidoscope throbs like an open wound, filling our skies with ominous, sickly patterns. Our priests believe it an ill omen. It may be wise to sacrifice some energy to the creature, to quench its hunger and appease our people's fears.

label.en: We shall not bend to its will.

texts.zh: 万华镜号渴求能量，它学会了如何从我们的舰队中吸取能量。尽管能量消耗很小，但对我们的航速有明显的影响。
texts.en: Hungry for energy, the Kaleidoscope has learned how to siphon energy from our fleet. The power drain is minimal, but is having a detectable impact on our ships' speed.

texts.zh:
开心的万华镜让[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的天空中涂满了令人愉悦的图形，一个个分型互相流变，带来了一波波变化万千的奇观。

整颗星球仿佛静止了。人们驻足欣赏，为之惊叹。
texts.en:
A happy Kaleidoscope fills [owner.capital_scope.GetName]'s skies with pleasing shapes, fractals melting into other fractals in ever-changing waves of wonder.

The planet stops. Admires. Breathes.

texts.zh: 万华镜不断变化的图案会不会是一种沟通的方式？或者这只是一种类似呼吸一般的自发流程？我们的[root.GetScientistPlural]尚未找到答案。万华镜也正在为我们带来不可估量的研究数据。
texts.en: Could the shifting patterns of the Kaleidoscope be a form of communication? Or are they an autonomous process, more akin to breathing? Our [root.GetScientistPlural] still don't have an answer. The Kaleidoscope is providing us with an invaluable amount of scientific data.

texts.zh: 万华镜寄生虫事实证明是一个异常好相处的邻居，但是要让它持续保持满足的心态不是一件容易的事情。建一个戴森球能不能满足它对能量的那种无底洞般的胃口呢？
texts.en: The Kaleidoscope has proven to be a strangely amiable neighbor, but keeping it sated has proven to be a challenge. Would a Dyson Sphere quench its endless thirst for energy?

label.zh: 为万华镜寄生虫提供一个改版戴森球。
label.en: Modify a Dyson Sphere for the Kaleidoscope.

tooltips.zh: 解锁一项新的戴森球升级。
tooltips.en: Unlock a new Dyson Sphere upgrade.

label.zh: 把戴森球改建为迪斯科球并完工
label.en: Upgrade a Dyson Sphere to the Disco Sphere and finish it

texts.zh:
万华镜寄生虫盘附在了我们提供的改版戴森球上，吞食着一整个恒星的能量，其不断延展的、色彩缤纷的花瓣包覆了整个恒星系。根据我们的数据，这个噬能生命体现在处于一种恒定的、可控的超载状态，在一个类似于死亡和重生的无尽循环中，不断地长出新芽，再不断地爆裂。

我们不知道这个生命体是否有思考能力，但我们希望它的存在本身现在和它产生的光图案一样令人愉快。
texts.en:
The Kaleidoscope has latched onto the modified Dyson Sphere we provided, consuming the energy of a star and extending its colorful petals to encompass the whole system. According to our data, the energy being is now in a state of constant, controlled overload, perpetually growing new buds and bursting in an endless cycle akin to death and rebirth.

We do not know if the being is capable of thought, but we hope its existence is now as pleasant as the patterns of light it produces.

note.zh: 移除万华镜并结束局势。
note.en: Removes the Kaleidoscope and ends the situation.

texts.zh: 我们的特工通过假扮成技工成功渗透进入了[target.GetName]的能源区划。他们的下一项任务是安装一个返航信标，诱惑能量寄生虫前来这个行星。
texts.en: By posing as technicians, our operatives successfully infiltrated the [target.GetName]'s energy districts. Their next assignment is to install a homing beacon to lure the energy parasite to the planet.

texts.zh:
我们天空中的异光消散了，提前宣告了我们的特工之后汇报的事情：他们激活了能量信标，将万华镜寄生虫引走了！

现在就让[target.GetName]去处理这麻烦吧。
texts.en:
The lights have faded from our skies, first announcing what our intelligence operatives later confirmed: our operators activated the energy beacon, luring the Kaleidoscope away!

Let the [target.GetName] deal with it now.

label.zh: 目标日后陷入能量赤字（30年内）
label.en: If the target later falls into an energy deficit (within 30 years)

note.zh: 本国局势销毁；目标帝国从头经历（首次为2003，曾拥有则直接2010）。
note.en: Your situation is destroyed; the target starts over (2003 the first time, 2010 if it hosted it before).

texts.zh: 依据我们的谍报信息，[kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName]，目前正遭遭受到能源短缺的困扰。我们送他们的万华镜似乎正是这一经济困境的主要起因。
texts.en: According to our espionage reports, [kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName], is currently suffering from an energy shortage. The Kaleidoscope we gifted them seems to be the main cause of their economic troubles.

texts.zh:
在在最后一阵红色的起伏图案爆发之后，万华镜消失了，它的彩色卷须像雾一样消散了。

在它的光芒下度过了这么长时间后，我们的天空看起来空落落的。
texts.en:
After a final burst of red, undulating patterns, the Kaleidoscope faded away, its colorful tendrils dissipating like mist.

After so much time spent beneath its lights, our skies look almost empty.

note.zh: 全局25年寿命标记到期后，月度检查使其消散。
note.en: When the 25-year global lifetime flag expires, the monthly check makes it fade.

texts.zh: 我们的传感器报告万华镜寄生虫发光图样的幻影出现在了[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系。这个现象的自然机理暂时还不清楚。
texts.en: Our sensors report the apparition of kaleidoscopic light patterns in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system. The nature of the phenomenon is unclear.

texts.zh: 我们先前观察到的万华镜幻影已经移动到了[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系。
texts.en: The kaleidoscopic apparition we previously observed has moved to the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system.

summary.text:
# 万华镜 / The Kaleidoscope

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · DLC：复仇女神 Nemesis（脚本检查 `has_nemesis`）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 开局时隐藏事件 1999 以 30% 概率设置全局标记，决定本局是否会出现万华镜。之后 `on_five_year_pulse` 每五年以 50/200 的权重运行隐藏事件 2000：须已进入游戏中期且万华镜尚未出现。2000 为能量寄生体选择宿主（人类玩家帝国 5、玩家的邻国 3、AI 帝国 1，首都不能有行星护盾），在 0–360 天后到达。
- At game start hidden event 1999 sets a global flag with 30% chance, deciding whether the Kaleidoscope can appear at all. Afterwards `on_five_year_pulse` runs hidden event 2000 with weight 50/200, once mid-game has begun and only if it has not started yet. 2000 picks the host (a human player's empire 5, a player's neighbour 3, an AI empire 1; the capital must not have a planetary shield); it arrives 0–360 days later.
- 首次接触的宿主看到 2003「太空之彩」（首都全球大停电、天空出现万花筒般的光幕），其他掌握该星系情报的帝国看到 2004。曾经拥有过它的帝国再次被选中时，跳过开场直接到 2010（「黑暗伊始」的“它回来了”版本）。
- A first-time host sees 2003 "Color Out of Space" (a planet-wide blackout at the capital and kaleidoscopic lights); empires with intel on the system see 2004. An empire that hosted it before skips the opening and goes straight to 2010 ("Black Start", the "it has returned" text).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 2003 → 特殊项目「能量停供」（200 工程研究，须工程船或方舟在轨道）；进度一半时 2005「大停电」，完成后 2010「黑暗伊始」。
   2003 → special project "Power Outage" (200 engineering, needs a construction ship or arkship in orbit); at 50% event 2005 "Blackout", on success 2010 "Black Start".
2. 2010 开启局势「万华镜」，玩家选择不喂养、少量喂养或大量喂养（三种接近方式，可随时切换）。不喂养不增加进度；少量 +0.5/月；大量 +1.5/月。月度隐藏事件 2001 记录全球进度并依喂养方式调整它的心情。
   2010 starts the situation "The Kaleidoscope" and asks how to feed it (starve / feed / overfeed; approaches can be changed later). Starving adds no progress, feeding 0.5/month, overfeeding 1.5/month. Hidden monthly event 2001 stores the global progress and moves its mood according to the approach.
3. 局势期间的每月随机插曲（可重复、顺序不定；无事权重 100，各事件 1，「无尽的饥饿」2）：
   Monthly random interludes while it lasts (repeatable, no fixed order; nothing 100, each event 1, "Endless Hunger" 2):
   - 不喂养时：2030 轻度侵染（另一颗行星停电 → 项目「流光溢彩」→ 2011）、2032 焦躁模式、2033 噩兆模式（仅唯心主义）、2034 幻吸模式；2031 电击疗法在非“大量喂养”时都可能发生。
     When starved: 2030 Minor Infestation (another planet blacks out → project "Color Bleed" → 2011), 2032 Unnerving Patterns, 2033 Ominous Patterns (spiritualists only), 2034 Pilfering Patterns; 2031 Electroshock can occur unless overfeeding.
   - 喂养时：2037 宽慰模式、2038 眩目模式、2048 无尽的饥饿（拥有完整或修复的戴森球且非排外）。
     When fed: 2037 Soothing Patterns, 2038 Dazzling Patterns, 2048 Endless Hunger (owns a finished or restored Dyson Sphere, not xenophobe).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

宿主的结局只会发生其一 / Only one of these ends it for the host:

- **撑爆 Burst（进度 100%）**：随机 2041「万华镜之花」（基础权重 10，获得遗珍“真空花朵”）或 2043「万华镜爆炸」（基础 90，星系殖民地荒芜度 +50），权重随心情值调整；他国分别收到 2042 / 2044。
  Random 2041 "Blooming Kaleidoscope" (base 10, grants the Vacuum Flower relic) or 2043 "Exploding Kaleidoscope" (base 90, +50 devastation in the system), weights shifted by its mood; others get 2042 / 2044.
- **消散 Fade**：全局 25 年寿命标记到期后，月度检查在 15 天后触发 2040「天清空净」，他国收到 2045。
  When the 25-year global lifetime flag expires, the monthly check fires 2040 "Clear Skies" 15 days later; others get 2045.
- **迪斯科球 Disco Sphere**：2048 选择改造戴森球后可建造“迪斯科球”升级（360 天）；完工触发 2049「奇迹球」，移除万华镜。
  After choosing 2048.a, the Disco Sphere upgrade of a Dyson Sphere can be built (360 days); completion fires 2049 "Wonder Sphere", removing the Kaleidoscope.
- **送给他国 Hand-off**：拥有万华镜的帝国可发动两阶段间谍行动「引诱万华镜」（2020 → 2021）。2021 销毁本国局势，目标帝国从 2003（或曾拥有者的 2010）重新开始；若目标在 30 年内陷入能量赤字，原宿主收到 2025「嫁祸于人」。
  The host can run the two-stage espionage operation "Lure the Kaleidoscope" (2020 → 2021). 2021 destroys your situation and the target starts over at 2003 (or 2010 if it hosted it before); if the target enters an energy deficit within 30 years, the former host receives 2025 "Offloading The Problem".
- 其他状态 Other state：宿主迁都时万华镜跟随新首都（隐藏 2050）；宿主被灭亡时，首都无护盾的征服者接手（2002），否则它消散并通知他国（隐藏 2060 → 2045）。
  It follows a capital move (hidden 2050); if the host is destroyed, an unshielded conqueror inherits it (2002), otherwise it fades and others are notified (hidden 2060 → 2045).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 2004 和 2010 各有两种正文：第一次看到/第一次拥有，或再次遇见/被送回。
  2004 and 2010 each have two texts: first sighting / first time hosting, or seen again / sent back.
- 2033 只对唯心主义帝国触发；2048 要求非排外并拥有完整或修复的戴森球。
  2033 only for spiritualist empires; 2048 needs a non-xenophobe owner with a completed or restored Dyson Sphere.
